plan.problem: The pricing documentation (pricing.md, business-model.md, projection.md) and payment/ledger files (payments.md, ledger.jsonl) need synchronization with the current record and sandbox flow. Pricing decisions remain CEO-only (proposal only), while payment mechanics must reflect the actual PayPal sandbox implementation.
plan.approach: Execute 'self' as a single agent session because all tasks involve reading/writing text-based configuration and data files within the same domain (finance/payments). The agent will read the source of truth (sandbox script and existing docs), then update each file to ensure consistency, verifying that no unauthorized price changes are applied.

steps.step: Read .benzene/scripts/paypal_sandbox.py to understand the current payment flow and state requirements for ledger.jsonl and payments.md.

Update .benzene/material/finance/pricing.md, business-model.md, and projection.md to ensure they accurately reflect the approved model (four tiers, between-jobs discount, 30-day refund) without introducing any price changes, noting any discrepancies as proposals for the CEO.
Update .benzene/material/finance/payments.md to reflect the flow defined in paypal_sandbox.py.
Initialize or update ledger.jsonl to be consistent with the sandbox flow described in paypal_sandbox.py.
Review the updated financial models. If the numbers indicate a misalignment requiring product changes (e.g., tier coverage gaps), output exactly one line: 'SUGGEST COO: <specific change>'.
